🚑 Quality checks and remaining work

  1. Resolve category uncertainty without discarding verified offers
    232 products still need category evidence. Their valid offers remain browsable under Needs category review; they are excluded from automatic meal matching.
  2. Recover source data before guessing from images
    1 products have no image-classifier row. Retailer product types, descriptions and explicit product forms take precedence over image guesses.
  3. Prefer source-backed rules over broad keyword guessing
    Use reliable source fields like Fresh Produce, retailer breadcrumbs, and product-detail metadata before adding keyword rules that can move drinks, supplements, or personal care into the wrong shelf.
  4. Use gold labels as training data
    Pick representative products from repeated failed brands and product families. One good label can help a whole cluster through the local text model.

Every box of this gluten free, sweetened, whole grain oat cereal brings the taste of real honey and natural almond flavor to your family table. Honey Nut Cheerios can help lower cholesterol* as part of a heart healthy diet. *Three grams of soluble fiber daily from whole grain oat foods, like Honey Nut Cheerios Cereal, in a diet low in saturated fat and cholesterol, may reduce the risk of heart disease. Honey Nut Cheerios Cereal provides .75g per serving. Each serving of Honey Nut Cheerios provides 22g of whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), 12 vitamins and minerals, and a good source of both calcium and fiber. Beyond a quick part of breakfast for adults or kids, these yummy whole grain cereal Os made with oats, make an easy, gluten free snack by the handful. Pack some crispy cereal in a lunch box for a sweet treat. Or use these honey cereal Os as an ingredient in your favorite cereal bars recipe. However you enjoy Honey Nut Cheerios, it's a part of General Mills breakfast cereals, spreading goodness from tots to grown-ups. retailer_description"Indulge in the creamy, mild flavor of Whole Foods Market Muenster Cheese. This premium 16-ounce package delivers the perfect balance of softness and texture that makes Muenster a beloved choice for sandwiches, burgers, and cheese boards. With its characteristic orange rind and pale interior, this semi-soft cheese melts beautifully, making it ideal for grilled cheese sandwiches or adding a gooey layer to your favorite dishes. Crafted with care, Whole Foods Market Muenster maintains the traditional quality you expect while offering versatility for both cooking and snacking. Enjoy it sliced with crackers, melted over potatoes, or incorporated into your favorite recipes for a touch of mild, buttery goodness that complements rather than overpowers other flavors."

retailer_description"Indulge in the creamy, mild flavor of Whole Foods Market Muenster Cheese. This premium 16-ounce package delivers the perfect balance of softness and texture that makes Muenster a beloved choice for sandwiches, burgers, and cheese boards. With its characteristic orange rind and pale interior, this semi-soft cheese melts beautifully, making it ideal for grilled cheese sandwiches or adding a gooey layer to your favorite dishes. Crafted with care, Whole Foods Market Muenster maintains the traditional quality you expect while offering versatility for both cooking and snacking. Enjoy it sliced with crackers, melted over potatoes, or incorporated into your favorite recipes for a touch of mild, buttery goodness that complements rather than overpowers other flavors."

retailer_description"\"At ALOHA, we believe that plants are the ultimate source of nourishment, and that real foods should be really convenient. So when you're looking for a great tasting, organic, plant-based protein boost, we've got you covered. ALOHA protein bars use simple, organic ingredients that are naturally packed with the tools your body needs to do its best: protein, iron, fiber, and healthy fats. With 14g clean protein and only 5g of cane sugar, ALOHA's protein bars are the perfect, healthy snack to tide you over. Our thoughtfully selected, plant-based protein is sourced from a balanced mix of organic pumpkin seed and organic brown rice, to deliver steady energy that will carry you through the day with no artificial ingredients or sugar alcohols. ALOHA's organic, plant-based products are vegan, non-GMO, gluten-free, soy-free, dairy-free (lactose-free), stevia-free, high protein, Kosher Certified and USDA certified organic. ALOHA checks all the boxes, so you can enjoy a tasty, nutritious snack without hesitation. All of our protein bars and protein products are made free of artificial ingredients and free of sugar alcohols, because we know that what you eat and how you feel are intimately connected. ALOHA Protein Bars are corn-free — our organic vegetable glycerin is derived from flax seed, not corn. ALOHA's organic, plant-based Chocolate Fudge Brownie protein bars use a short line of organic, whole-food ingredients that are delicious and self-explanatory: like real, organic dark chocolate, organic cashew butter, and organic cocoa powder. The perfect protein bar for when you're between meetings, warming up for the gym (or cooling down!), on the road, taking a pit-stop on your weekend cycle, or looking for an easy, nutritious option at home. The search for a healthy, satisfying, go-to snack is over: sit back and enjoy a great tasting, rejuvenating ALOHA protein bar.\""

retailer_description"Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beers provide the perfect alternative for those who want to enjoy the taste of craft beer without the hangover. Whether you’re craving a crisp IPA, a smooth golden, or a light, refreshing brew, we offer a wide range of styles to satisfy your taste buds. Made with the finest ingredients, our beers include malted barley, hops, yeast, water, and wheat, ensuring a well-balanced, flavorful brew. The secret behind our great taste lies in our careful brewing method, which allows us to craft each Non Alcoholic beer with the same passion and precision as traditional craft brews, while maintaining the same flavor. Perfect for those looking for a mindful alcohol alternative, our beers contain less than 0.5% alcohol by volume, making them suitable for any time of the day. Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beers are designed for active, health-conscious individuals who love the taste of brews but want to make mindful choices. Our Non Alcoholic beer selection includes classics like Run Wild IPA, Upside Dawn Golden, Athletic Lite, and Free Wave, with regular releases of unique styles and experimental brews that showcase our passion for innovation. Each brew is carefully crafted to provide the same depth of flavor you’d expect from a traditional craft beer, without the unwanted effects. Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beer is your go-to drink. It’s a great fit for any lifestyle, whether you’re indulging in pizza, a salad, or grilling. Perfectly paired with a variety of meals, desserts, and activities, it’s a refreshing choice for anyone who wants to enjoy the taste of beer without the alcohol. With a variety of styles to choose from, including hazy IPAs and light and dark brews, there’s a flavor to suit every palate. From casual drinking to special occasions, Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beers let you enjoy the best of both worlds: the refreshing taste of craft beer and the benefits of choosing a Non Alcoholic beverage."

retailer_description"GT's SYNERGY Watermelon Wonder Kombucha is crafted by nature for the living body. Refreshing, juicy, and naturally sweet. Traditionally fermented in small batches for weeks—not days—using heirloom Himalayan cultures, it delivers billions of living probiotics to support gut health, immunity, brain function, and protein absorption. Since 1995, GT's Living Foods has been crafting functional recipes inspired by nature's healing properties. The family-owned and operated company has created a diverse portfolio of delicious and efficacious living foods for the living body. Each is made with the same unwavering commitment to real fermentation, real function, and real benefits as SYNERGY."
